entities.name: PMID:25427013
observations: 2014 cross-sectional study of 2,980 schoolchildren aged 6–14 years in Santiago, Chile; pubertal stage grouped as Tanner I–II versus III–V.

entities.name: WHtR stable across groups
observations: Authors reported no variation in waist-to-height ratio by sex, chronological age, or pubertal stage; the age-adjusted gender/puberty comparison was nonsignificant (p=0.409). This cross-sectional null finding does not establish universal absence of change.
